name: Universal Autofoundry Limited
about: Universal Autofoundry Limited manufactures and sells cast iron and ductile iron castings for the automobiles, earth movers, agriculture, railway, and international market in India and internationally. The company offers suspension brackets, wheel hubs, brakedrum, fly wheels, engine block caps, differential cases, crank bearing housing products, brake housing products, differential ceaselessly products, lift arms, hydraulic lift cylinders, adaptor plates, transmission parts, and engine mounting brackets for commercial vehicles. It also provides gear box housings, hubs, trumpets, support pulleys, case PTO products, clutch housings, transmission housings, cylinder hydraulic lifts, rockers, and other brackets for tractor industry; axle and transmission castings, gear box housings, and drive heads for earth movers industry; anchor bodies for construction industry; and compressor parts, pump bodies, and gate valve assemblies for other engineering parts. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Jaipur, India.
